Find a Summer Camp
Find the Camp Program That’s Right for Your Child
Discover the many different programs open to youth aged 7 to 17 at our gorgeous site in Saint-Sauveur! Youth can enjoy a stay at camp, go on a canoe-tripping expedition, or explore their leadership skills. Our beautiful site borders three private lakes and boasts
various facilities
to practise a wide range of sports and water activities. Whether you want to sit around the camp fire, discover Kanwana's group spirit, or proudly set off on an adventure, there is something for every taste.
Registration for the 2027 season at YMCA Kanawana Camp is about to open!

Interested in Learning More About Camp YMCA Kanawana?
Before signing up, take a moment to discover everything that makes Kanawana unique: its camp site in the heart of nature, its century-old history, its passionate team, and so much more.
